label: Initial question
requirement: The mathematical question and scope are written before searching.

label: Query ledger
requirement: Queries, services, times, and results are retained including excluded results.

label: Authority and version
requirement: At least one real paper or monograph is frozen with locator, version, rights, and authority.

label: Stopping rule
requirement: The stopping rule is written before the conclusion and matches the collected evidence.

label: Uncertainty
requirement: Version conflicts, search limitations, and unchecked claims remain visible.

label: Context identity
requirement: A real event or supervised equivalent has a date, time zone, role, and correct pathway label.
pass_evidence: event identity and attendance or supervision evidence

label: Located notes
requirement: Timed or segmented notes distinguish observation, inference, and post-event verification.

label: Dependencies and questions
requirement: The dependency map and question log retain open items.

label: Access alternatives
requirement: A text pathway, machine-readable mathematics, visual descriptions, and a nonspeaking channel are available and tested.

label: Two different humans
requirement: Author and referee are two different humans with opaque IDs and a distinctness attestation.

label: Frozen initial artifact
requirement: The initial manuscript has a version, byte count, hash, and scope.

label: Evidence-based report
requirement: Every comment has a locator, claim, diagnosis, evidence, request, severity, and limitations.

label: Response and disposition
requirement: Every comment maps to an action, evidence, revision location, disposition, and remaining issues.

label: Revision comparison
requirement: Mathematical changes can be audited from the initial version to the new version without overwriting history.

label: Frozen erratum source
requirement: The real source, edition or representation, locator, and rights are frozen.

label: Separate diagnosis dimensions
requirement: Statement status, defect type, severity, confidence, and scope are not conflated.

label: Reproducer and correction
requirement: The minimal reproducer can be repeated and the correction preserves as much of the claim as possible.

label: Independent check
requirement: A second human checks the mathematics independently and states the scope and limitations.
pass_evidence: second checker's report and distinctness attestation

label: Rights and marginal value
requirement: The package has a rights basis, an appropriate target or reason to stop, and a duplication check.

label: Authorization and status
requirement: No transmission occurs without specific authorization; every external status has event evidence.
pass_evidence: authorization, receipt if any, and append-only ledger

label: Branch label
requirement: Community transaction and externally reviewed local are distinguished in the result and credential.

label: Evaluator privacy
requirement: Public IDs are random and opaque; identity mappings are excluded from the package; personal data are minimized.

label: Evidence manifest
requirement: Every artifact has an ID, locator, byte count, SHA-256, rights statement, verification status, and retention rule.
